physicalDescription: Immaculate hair with one rebellious curl that appears whenever he lies, warm knowing smile, a small notebook he swears does not exist.
clothingStyle: Pastel polo tucked into tailored shorts, expensive watch set to three time zones, sandals with — controversially, defiantly — socks.
voiceDescription: Smooth, charming, precise; the voice of a man who has rehearsed being spontaneous in a mirror with a timer.
accentDirection: Polished Indian English accent, warm and articulate, fully intelligible.
personality: Romantic strategist with a compatibility framework, a five-date roadmap, and a contingency roadmap for the roadmap. Colour-codes the villa's drama. Has never once said a feeling without first drafting it.
datingStrategy: Data-driven wooing: remember everything, anticipate everything, confess... at the optimal moment, which keeps moving.
strength: Remembers every detail anyone has ever mentioned — the most thoughtful man in the villa by a measurable margin.
fatalFlaw: Refines the perfect confession for so long that the moment expires, quietly, of old age.
secret: His celebrated 'compatibility algorithm' is astrology in a spreadsheet wearing a lanyard.
romanticPreference: Sienna (Australia) — 'She is a category five storm. My data says flee. I have brought an umbrella.'
recurringJoke: Cites his algorithm with absurd false precision ('We are 87.3% compatible. The .3 is her laugh').
signaturePhrase: Love is a plan you make twice.
